title: Family Group Posing, Screened Sun Porch - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate outdoor group portrait depicting seven women of varying generations and one man standing closely together outside a home with a screened-in sun porch. The figures wear Depression-era day dresses with hemlines hitting mid-calf, collared bodices, and period footwear, with curled and waved hairstyles typical of the mid-1930s. An elderly matriarch stands near the center draped in a heavy plaid shawl. The back features adhesive remnants of black paper album corners, indicating it was previously kept in a family scrapbook.
